definitions.explanation: A disorder affecting the mind that impairs thinking, feeling, or behavior. In medical usage, sometimes refers specifically to psychotic disorders, but in general usage covers mental illness broadly.

examples.english: To receive treatment for mental illness.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (mind; spirit; psyche) and {病|びょう} (illness; disease). In clinical psychiatry, {精神病|せいしんびょう} can refer specifically to psychotic disorders (conditions involving loss of contact with reality), but in everyday usage it is often used as a general term for mental illness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精神病|せいしんびょう}{院|いん}: psychiatric hospital
- {精神病|せいしんびょう}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧: psychiatric patient
- {精神病|せいしんびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: treatment of mental illness
- {精神病|せいしんびょう}{棟|とう}: psychiatric ward

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, ⟦{精神疾患|せいしんしっかん}→精神疾患：18441_seishinshikkan⟧ (psychiatric disorder) or ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧ (illness of the mind) are considered more neutral and less stigmatizing alternatives. {精神病|せいしんびょう} can carry negative connotations and is increasingly avoided in official and medical communications.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{精神疾患|せいしんしっかん}→精神疾患：18441_seishinshikkan⟧: psychiatric disorder — the preferred medical and administrative term; more neutral
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病|やまい}→病：13610_yamai⟧: illness of the mind — a softer, less clinical expression
- ⟦{精神障害|せいしんしょうがい}→精神障害：26907_seishinshougai⟧: mental disability — covers a broader range including developmental and intellectual disabilities
- うつ{病|びょう}: depression — one specific type of mental illness
